method: Owner-directed isolated native enrollment after seven exact-head CI workflow jobs passed; separate generated identities and private state, existing local base images with 183 frozen own Python source modules mounted read-only. This is an exact-module experiment, not release-image qualification.
limitations: The native Key request establishes this route and input field types on Protect 7.4.96, not universal necessity or validity of every optional field on every processor profile.
Existing project-defined metadata policies remain separately classified; no broad shared-context reclassification is inferred from this one request.
The Port enrollment used /api/1.2/manage and did not emit /api/1.2/login; absence is not provenance proof for the login route.
No camera binding, media retrieval, inference, model download, provider change, existing-device restart, firmware fetch or private disassembly was introduced.
Snapshot and reverification target/callback paths were not exercised by these enrollment-only trials and remain unresolved.
Eleven before/after recording-state/configuration snapshots do not establish uninterrupted video at every timestamp.
The first private rotation projection read a nonexistent management_password_hash field; the corrected source-grounded presence check uses credential.hash and never exports its value.
No rights approval, owner/reviewer attestation, merge, release, tag or registry publication.
